takenRequests.title: Three strength sessions
takenRequests.description: Complete three strength sessions with recovery days. Record the exercises and repetitions.

takenRequests.title: Networking field assignment
takenRequests.description: Complete three focused practice sessions. Design and validate a small switched and routed network, including addressing, VLANs, security, and documentation.

takenRequests.title: Warrior commission
takenRequests.description: Complete individual practice toward this class goal: Build muscular strength with bodyweight exercises or weights. Use a recording, simulation, or checked example to demonstrate a correction or application; choose the next progression.

takenRequests.title: Warrior training adventure
takenRequests.description: Build a sustainable month of warrior practice. Complete each milestone before claiming the adventure.

takenRequests.title: Brisk walk for 30 minutes
takenRequests.description: Walk at a pace where conversation is possible but singing is difficult. Include an easy warm-up and cool-down.

takenRequests.title: Scripture comprehension
takenRequests.description: Read a passage, explain its central meaning in your own words, and check that explanation against the context.

takenRequests.title: Spaced retrieval session
takenRequests.description: Use twenty minutes of active recall on earlier material. Check errors and schedule another review.

takenRequests.title: Networking practice
takenRequests.description: Work independently on Networking using a written case, simulation, or practical exercise. Check the result against a source or marking guide and record one correction.
